newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - St. Peters, Mo.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - St. Peters, Mo.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
City of St. Peters, Missouri
General Obligation Refunding Bonds, Series 1997
(Bank Qualified)
SEALED BIDS will be received until 11:00 a.m., Central Time on
February 13, 1997
All bids will be publicly opened and read at said time and place. The award of the Bonds will be acted upon at a meeting of the Board of Aldermen to be held at 7:30 p.m. on said date.

Each bid must be enclosed in a sealed envelope addressed to the undersigned and marked Proposal for the Purchase of Bonds.'' Bids may be submitted by mail or delivered in person addressed to Timothy Wilkinson, Director of Finance, at the St. Peters City Hall, One St. Peters Centre Blvd., St. Peters, Missouri 63376 or by calling in the bid to the City's Financial Advisor as provided in the Notice of Bond Sale.

The Bonds will consist of fully registered bonds in the denomination of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof. The Bonds will be dated February 26, 1997 and will mature serially, without option for early redemption, on September 1 in each year as follows:
Year Amount* Year Amount*

*Individual maturities may be increased or decreased by up to $25,000 on the date of sale as further described in the Notice of Bond Sale. The Bonds will bear interest from their date at the rates to be determined when the Bonds are sold, which interest will be payable on September 1, 1997 and semiannually thereafter on March 1 and September 1. The payment of the principal of and interest on the Bonds when due will be insured by a municipal bond insurance policy to be issued by Financial Guaranty Insurance Company simultaneously with the delivery of the Bonds. The policy will be paid for by the City. A description of the policy and the ratings assigned to the Bonds as a result of such policy is described in the Preliminary Official Statement. UMB Bank, N.A., Kansas City, Missouri is the bond
registrar and paying agent. The Bonds are general

obligations of the City and are payable as to both principal and interest from ad valorem taxes which may be levied, without limitation as to rate or amount, on all taxable tangible property, real and personal, within the corporate limits of the City. The City will furnish Bonds and the approving opinion of Thompson Coburn, Bond Counsel, St.

Louis, Missouri, to the bidder awarded the Bonds. Bids be for all of the Bonds at a price of not less than 99.0% of the principal amount plus accrued interest to the date of delivery. All bonds must be reoffered at 100% plus accrued interest to the date of delivery. All bids must be submitted on the Official Bid Form which, together with the Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Bond Sale, may be obtained from the City or its financial advisor at the addresses indicated below:
Timothy Wilkinson WM Financial Strategies
Director of Finance 1515 N. Warson
St. Peters City Hall Suite 274
One St. Peters Centre Blvd. St. Louis, Missouri, 63132
St. Peters, Missouri 63376 Attention: Ms. Joy A. Howard
(From The Bond Buyer)
